user.title: Matter Manager
user.description: Connects the manager to your Matter Server (python-matter-server). The address is taken from the Matter integration when possible.

data_description.url: WebSocket address, e.g. ws://core-matter-server:5580/ws (Matter Server add-on) or ws://192.168.1.10:5580/ws.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Matter Server. Is it running and is the address correct?
error.not_matter_server: The address responds, but not like a Matter Server.

abort.already_configured: An entry for this address already exists.

data.nc_enabled: Send messages to the Notification Center

data_description.critical_battery_threshold: Must be less than or equal to the “low battery” threshold.
data_description.fire_events: Fires e.g. matter_manager_device_offline, _battery_low and _update_available – usable as automation triggers.
data_description.nc_enabled: Only has an effect if the Notification Center is installed. Without it, nothing happens.
data_description.nc_types: Sorted by urgency. Deselected types are not sent.

error.critical_above_low: The critical threshold must not exceed the “low” threshold.

commission.name: Add device
commission.description: Commissions a Matter device with its setup code (pairing).

code.name: Setup code
code.description: QR text (MT:…) or numeric code (11 or 21 digits).

network_only.name: Network only
network_only.description: Search the existing network only, not via Bluetooth.

check_updates.name: Check for firmware updates
check_updates.description: Checks all OTA-capable devices for updates in the background.
